label: Diagram 5.5
caption: Diagram 5.5 Internal floor type A
description: Diagram 5.5, titled "Internal floor type A", is a horizontal cross-section, as indicated by the word "SECTION" printed in the lower right corner of the framed drawing. Within the framed drawing there are no other text labels, dimensions or symbols. The section is built up in horizontal layers. The topmost is a thin band filled with a fine speckled or dotted pattern. Beneath it lies a thicker band containing a row of small, evenly spaced circles running across the width. At the centre of the row one of these circles is shaded grey; from it a short vertical line rises up through the top speckled band and ends in a small U-shaped opening at its top. Below the circular band there is an open gap, then two horizontal lines running the full width of the section, between which are three square supports, each drawn with a diagonal cross (X) inside, spaced towards the left, the centre and the right, forming a row of supports beneath the floor structure.
